name: Midou Takanori
source:
"Incompetent people are not needed for this project."

He belongs to the Product Development Department of the pharmaceutical company, MGN Japan, which is the parent company of Katsuya's company. A young, ambitious elite who never misses a chance, he rose to the position of department head with exceptional speed. He serves as the project manager for a new product for which Katsuya and the others are working to develop sales channels.
